LESSON: PHOTOGRAPHY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.6: Photography
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Photography, part of Creating and Performing in Grade 9 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS.

Key inquiry question: Which are the ethical issues to consider in photography?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. observe virtual and /or actual samples of photographs to analyse the bird’s, normal and worm’s viewpoints,

2. research/take a field walk to explore and identify scenic point in the surroundings,

3. take photographs inspired by the environment to showcase beautiful scenes in our country (Kenya) focusing on; varied scene and viewpoints,

4. select and store the photographs in an E folder to make a still/slide presentation,

5. make a presentation for own reflection and peer feedback in a just manner.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. observe virtual and /or actual samples of photographs to analyse the bird’s, normal and worm’s viewpoints,
2. research/take a field walk to explore and identify scenic point in the surroundings,
3. take photographs inspired by the environment to showcase beautiful scenes in our country (Kenya) focusing on; varied scene and viewpoints,
4. select and store the photographs in an E folder to make a still/slide presentation,
5. make a presentation for own reflection and peer feedback in a just manner.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Photography together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: learner visit their surroundings to take photographs to showcase beautiful scenes in our country (Kenya).

• Creativity and Imagination: learner evaluates and selects photograph, considering different viewpoints and perspectives, and

makes informed decisions during the editing process.

Values:
Respect: learner present their photographs and give feedback in a just manner..

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental Awareness: learner appreciate beautiful environment as they take a field walk to explore and identify scenic

point in the surroundings

Link to other learning areas:

Social Studies: Understanding the geographical and environmental aspects of different viewpoints in landscape photography.
